Here is a summary of Alberto Carbonell's profile, experience, stack and projects:

**Profile:**
- **Name:** Alberto Carbonell
- **Title:** Senior Software Engineer — AI Agents & Full-Stack TypeScript
- **Location:** Spain · Remote
- **Tagline:** Senior engineer, 10+ years with TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL. I build AI agents that do real work end to end.
- **Summary:** Senior engineer with 10+ years shipping production software in TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL. Lately my focus has been building AI agents that handle real work end to end, wired into the tools and data a business already uses. With AI in the loop I ramp up fast on any new stack; what never changes is the fundamentals: clean design, tests and code that's easy to maintain.
- **Education:** Higher Technical Diplomas (CFGS) in Web Development, Multiplatform Development and Systems Administration at CIFP Rodolfo Ucha Piñeiro (2010 — 2015).
- **Languages:** Spanish (Native), English (C1).

**Experience:**
- **CoverWallet (2019 — now):** Senior Software Engineer in Madrid / Remote. Highlights include leading cross-team projects, integrating third-party insurance carrier APIs, introducing AI agents into the engineering workflow, and mentoring new hires. Stack: TypeScript, Node.js, React, Ruby on Rails.
- **M&GT Consulting (2016 — 2019):** Software Developer in Madrid. Built REST APIs and web/mobile apps for large international clients, delivered blockchain solutions on Hyperledger Fabric and Ethereum. Stack: Node.js, REST, iOS, Android, Hyperledger Fabric, Ethereum.
- **Indra (2015 — 2016):** Software Developer in A Coruña. Worked with Java/Spring and Oracle PL/SQL for telecom clients; QA and hotfixes. Stack: Java, Spring, Oracle PL/SQL.

**Stack:**
- **AI / agents:** Claude, Grok, Open-source models (cloud and local via Ollama), Tool calling, MCP, Agent evals and monitoring.
- **Languages:** TypeScript, JavaScript, Ruby.
- **Backend & data:** Node.js, NestJS, Express, Next.js, REST, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB.
- **Infra:** Docker, Kubernetes, CircleCI, Vercel, Railway, Neon, GCP.
- **Frontend:** React, React Native, Angular.

**Projects:**
- **Fraud Detection Agent (offline-evals):** Reviews newly published events and organizers on an event ticketing platform and leaves an approve / reject / request-info recommendation, with its reasons, for a human admin. Graded autonomy: it auto-approves only on evidence verified in code, and web sources can hold a decision back but never approve it. Offline evals, 31 cases: on a local 9B model, approved fraud fell from 54% to 8% over twelve iterations, and fraud approved without a human from 27% to 0%. Claude Haiku 5.5, chosen for deployment: 86% accuracy vs 71%, 1% of fraud approved vs 8%. Stack: TypeScript, PostgreSQL, GCP.
- **Organizer Support Agent (coming-soon):** Answers event organizers' questions about sales, payouts and setup without human review, pulling live data from PostgreSQL and the payments API. Stack: TypeScript, Tool calling, MCP, PostgreSQL.
- **Portfolio Agent (personal-project):** Agent on my portfolio site that answers visitors' questions about my experience and projects in natural language. Also exposed as an MCP server so external agents can query it. Stack: TypeScript, Claude, MCP.

**Practices:**
- Offline evals before shipping.
- Graded autonomy, a human in the loop.
- Cost and limits tracked.
- Changes measured run over run.
